_doc: In-game radio (client only; src/client/radio.ts). ] next station, [ previous, \ radio on/off; gamepad select/share = next. volume is linear. synth: lofi, punk or hyphy = generated in the browser (no stream); songs = made-up titles shown as each generated song starts. dj: its station ID (id) is said just after tuning in, then one of lines every every songs, in turn; the music ducks to duck of its level while the DJ talks (lines in data/voices.json). A station may instead give url (a stream played from the station's own server) and home (its page, shown when you tune in). The release ships only the generated stations: a live stream needs the station's written permission for third-party players (docs/roadmap.md, Radio). pollSeconds is kept for streams.
